# Signal Weekly — Nov 17–Nov 24, 2026

*Nov 17–Nov 24, 2026*

This week’s digest spotlights AI’s growing influence—from code reviews to market moves—while reminding us that tech’s rapid pace also brings legal and safety challenges. We’ve handpicked stories that span industry, research, and everyday gadgets.

## Tech news

- **[Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/23/anthropic-launches-claude-ship-letting-ai-agents-review-fix-and-approve-code-changes/)** (TechCrunch) — Claude Ship lets developers slash manual review time by letting AI agents handle code changes.
- **[Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/23/supertake-raises-20m-to-let-ai-agents-turn-your-market-predictions-into-stock-portfolios/)** (TechCrunch) — Supertake’s new funding fuels AI‑driven trading, promising faster, more automated portfolio creation.
- **[States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/states-sue-spacex-to-stop-grok-from-generating-child-sex-images-revenge-porn/)** (Ars Technica) — A lawsuit against SpaceX highlights looming legal risks for AI content moderation.
- **[Measuring Verification Gaps In LLM-Generated Post-Quantum Hardware (Lucid, EYL)](https://semiengineering.com/measuring-verification-gaps-in-llm-generated-post-quantum-hardware-lucid-eyl/)** (SemiEngineering) — The paper warns of security gaps when AI designs post‑quantum hardware without proper verification.

## Reviews

- **[Your questions about Apple HomeView’s audio, answered](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038713/apple-homeview-audio-smart-speaker-spotify-airplay)** (The Verge Reviews) — Apple HomeView’s audio falls short, and limited app support could dampen the smart‑home experience.

---

Stay curious, stay cautious, and keep exploring what tech can—and can’t—do this week.
